content: Real-time leaderboard best practice: use append/aggregate score events (Redis sorted sets or SUM aggregation) rather than mutable running totals; push leaderboard-updated events over WS/Socket.IO after each score change; persist source-of-truth in durable store (Postgres/DynamoDB) with cache/sorted-set as read accelerator; authenticate WS connections (JWT), rate-limit per-connection messages, isolate broadcast rooms per game.
